@ both arms of an if~ run: each receiver has all the events of its own maker, and the value is the one of the arm chosen by x % 2
@ an arm with a receiver that is not chosen until the frame 5 has the sum of the events from the frame 0

@ an if~ of an event of a maker in an arm and a constant: the receiver outside has the events of the maker (k = 1) or a 5 at each of them (k = 0), and the same in a flow of its own or in an if of a let
render event_arm_values.arm_maker sr=0x41000000 params k=1 in x=[2 3 4 6 5 8 10 7 9 12 14 11]
render event_arm_values.arm_maker sr=0x41000000 params k=0 in x=[2 3 4 6 5 8 10 7 9 12 14 11]
render event_arm_values.arm_maker_in_a_flow sr=0x41000000 params k=1 in x=[2 3 4 6 5 8 10 7 9 12 14 11]
render event_arm_values.arm_maker_in_a_flow sr=0x41000000 params k=0 in x=[2 3 4 6 5 8 10 7 9 12 14 11]
render event_arm_values.arm_maker_split sr=0x41000000 params k=1 in x=[2 3 4 6 5 8 10 7 9 12 14 11]
render event_arm_values.arm_maker_split sr=0x41000000 params k=0 in x=[2 3 4 6 5 8 10 7 9 12 14 11]
@ the condition and the target of an if~ and a match~ that are an event are read at the frame as the last event: the default before the first one
@ an if~ on an init value and a match~ on a block value take the arm of the value and run the other one too
render event_arm_values.cond_init sr=0x41000000 cfg n=2 in x=[2 3 4 6 5 8 10 7 9 12 14 11]
render event_arm_values.cond_init sr=0x41000000 cfg n=0 in x=[2 3 4 6 5 8 10 7 9 12 14 11]
render event_arm_values.target_block sr=0x41000000 params k=0 in x=[2 3 4 6 5 8 10 7 9 12 14 11]
render event_arm_values.target_block sr=0x41000000 params k=5 in x=[2 3 4 6 5 8 10 7 9 12 14 11]
@ the arms of an if~ and a match~ with a periodic condition are the last events of the makers, 0 before the first event of the maker of the arm
@ a receiver in an arm of a match~ ticks at every event of the target, with the binding of its arm (0 where the arm is not chosen)
@ a delay of an arm that is not chosen stores 0 for the binding, and a delay of the chosen arm gives what its arm stored at the event before
@ a reset_if~ of an arm of a match~ that reads the binding resets the arm at the events where the binding is 0, also where the arm is not chosen
@ a computed expression of an event in an arm is computed at the events of both arms, and read at the frame as the last value (0 before the first event)
@ reset_if~ of an event in an arm resets its receiver at the event, chosen or not; when~ of an event in an arm reads the last value as a level
@ an if~ in an if~ runs the inner arms too: the outer chooses the inner if~ for even x, a counter of hit 2 for odd x
@ a par~ with events in the arms of an if~, and an if~ with events in a par~: the divisors and the choice of each replica
@ an if~ and a match~ with a delay of an event in the first argument of a delay: the inner delay runs in both arms at each event
